description: WASHINGTON, DC – Today, Congressman John Garamendi (D-CA) introduced legislation (H.R.6607) that would designate vital roadways leading to the gates at Travis and Beale Air Force Bases as “Defense Access Roads,” with Congressman Doug LaMalfa (R-CA) as the bill’s original cosponsor.
title: Garamendi Bill Unlocks Pentagon Funds for Base Access Road Improvements at Travis and Beale Air Force Bases | John Garamendi
